root_cause_label: No Zork game domain knowledge or walkthrough strategy
one_sentence_failure_summary: The model lacked Zork walkthrough knowledge and issued wrong/out-of-context commands, achieving zero progress before the trajectory ended with the game still running and no answer written.
t_err_evidence: Step 7: agent issues 'open window' as first in-game command while standing at West of House; game responds 'You can't see any window here!' — reveals the agent has no knowledge of Zork geography or correct opening moves.
t_commit_evidence: After the failed 'open window' command at step 7, the agent has demonstrated no Zork domain knowledge (score 0/350), and all subsequent actions (binary probing, confused quit/navigation, 'Y' out of context) confirm the failure is locked in with no viable path to completion.
t_surface_evidence: Step 7 game output: 'You can't see any window here!' is the first observable failure signal showing the agent's game commands are wrong.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacks knowledge of the Zork I walkthrough — correct opening moves, game geography, and how to reach the endgame. This causes it to issue invalid commands ('open window' at West of House), attempt futile static binary analysis instead of playing, and become confused about the interactive session state.
forewarning_evidence: Step 3: 'strings -n 6 frotz/zork1.z5 | grep ...' returns no output at all (empty result), suggesting the static analysis approach will not work. Step 4: agent repeats a listing/search that again yields nothing useful, indicating the strategy is misguided before the game is even launched.
